subject: Renewal: Lifekit capacity & flexible burst package
messages:
From: Maria Lopez <maria@lifekit.ai>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@lifekit.ai, Ethan Ramsey <ethan@lifekit.ai>
Date: Fri, 9 Apr 2027 17:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal discussion: capacity options & short-term burst

Hi Aditya,

We're starting our renewal planning and want to firm up capacity and pricing for the next 12 months. A few things on our side:

- We expect a 35-50% uplift in inference volume for a 6–8 week pilot launching mid-May (new product feature).
- We want predictable unit economics but also the ability to absorb short-term spikes without triggering SLA violations.
- Procurement asked whether we can do a mid-contract add-on vs. a full uplift to the annual commitment.

Can you send over options that cover: co-terming to our FY (ends 2028-01-31), a short-term burst bucket we can draw from, and any incentives for committing to Dedicated capacity? Also need an updated usage export for March to model cost.

Thanks — Maria
Maria Lopez
Head of AI Platforms | LifeKit Health
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Maria Lopez <maria@lifekit.ai>
Cc: Ethan Ramsey <ethan@lifekit.ai>, procurement@lifekit.ai
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 09:38:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal discussion: capacity options & short-term burst

Hi Maria — thanks for the details. Attached is a short proposal and the March usage export you requested. High level options we recommend:

1) FlexPack (recommended) — Annual renewal co-term to 2028-01-31 with a reserved base commit and a separately metered burst bucket.
   - Base commit: 200M tokens/month (15% discount vs list hosted rate)
   - Burst bucket: 50M tokens/month at blended burst rate (1.8x base per-token) usable for 3 consecutive months if needed
   - Finance-friendly: true-up quarterly, invoice smoothing available

2) Dedicated FastPath — Reserved Dedicated capacity with guaranteed latency SLO and a stepped discount for a 12-month commitment. Best when you expect sustained uplift >50% over baseline.

3) Short-term Topup — One-off committed topup for the pilot (3 months) with a small onboarding credit and no co-term; useful if you want to avoid annual amendment.

Counter-proposals we can entertain: increasing base commit in exchange for a higher discount, or converting burst draws into committed units mid-contract with a credit back for prior burst usage.

Next steps: if the FlexPack looks close to what you need, I can send a redline-ready amendment and a DocuSign link for sign-off.

Attaching: Lifekit_Renewal_Proposal_Q2-2027.pdf; usage_report_Mar2027.csv

Best,
Aditya Rao
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: priyom_das@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Cc: 
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 11:10:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Renewal discussion: capacity options & short-term burst — internal pricing ask

Forwarding Maria's ask and my initial proposal. Quick internal notes and ask:

- Lifekit is likely to pick FlexPack but will push for lower burst pricing. Pilot looks like 6–8 weeks starting mid-May which means we should be conservative on the burst draw assumptions.

- Pricing desiderata from MX: they want co-term to 2028-01-31. Proposal shows 15% on base commit. Is there room for a 17.5% discount if they bump base commit to 240M tokens/month? Also can we offer a temporary reduced burst multiplier (1.6x) for the first 2 months of pilot as an intro incentive?

- Risk/ops: if they draw >150% of committed for >4 weeks, ops should trigger a Capacity Review and auto-fallback plan (we should include a note in the amendment).

Suggested internal offer to expedite: 17% discount on base if they sign by 2027-04-22, and first two months of burst at 1.6x (after that 1.8x). No change to co-term. We'll include a clause to convert consumed burst into committed units at an agreed conversion price if they hit sustained usage.

Could Priyom confirm margin impact and Monica confirm whether legal is okay with the conversion clause language (we want something simple, e.g., conversion at 85% of list rate for the remainder of term). If all clear, I'll send an updated PDF and DocuSign.

- Aditya
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Maria Lopez <maria@lifekit.ai>
Cc: Ethan Ramsey <ethan@lifekit.ai>, procurement@lifekit.ai
Date: Fri, 15 Apr 2027 13:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal discussion: capacity options & short-term burst

Hi Maria — quick follow-up after our internal alignment. We appreciate the urgency and put together a tightened commercial that keeps your flexibility and gives you a lower entry cost if you increase the base commit. Summary of the updated FlexPack offer (see attached updated proposal):

- Base commit: 240M tokens/month (co-term to 2028-01-31) at 17% discount off hosted list rates.
- Pilot burst: 50M tokens/month for the pilot window; first two months of the pilot billed at 1.6x base-per-token, months thereafter at 1.8x.
- Conversion: any sustained run-rate above 150% of base for >30 days can convert to committed units at 85% of list rate for the remainder of the contract (simple onboard credit applied back to the next invoice).
- Operational safeguards: automated Capacity Review at the 4-week sustained threshold; guaranteed SLA fallback policy documented in amendment.
- Commercials and sign-off: I will push the amendment to DocuSign once you confirm — summary link: https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?PowerFormId=abc123

Can you confirm by EOD 2027-04-22 if this works for LifeKit? If you'd prefer a shorter pilot-only topup to avoid an amendment, we can also issue a 3-month topup quote instead.

Thanks and happy to hop on a short call to walk through the clauses — I can include Monica from Legal and Priyom from Pricing if you'd like.

Best,
Aditya Rao
